scope: One explicit compact evidence projection, same frozen BGE candidates and atomic cap5. Controlled retrieval I/O, real tool/runtime/admission and real answer API. Not live production E2E or Formal Experiment.
development: all160 already exposed official train questions from scenario-rag-20261023/musique-dev-1
confirmation: Only if development accepts quality or efficiency:200 seeded official dev question IDs excluding previously exposed300+200. Register source overlap limits; no method reselection.

profiles.legacy5: Prior accepted rag_records_v1 at8000, NOT historical generic4000 baseline
profiles.compact5: Only new frozen evidence_projection=compact_v1; same rank scores, max5 atoms, snippet1000, budget8000; actual model-view bytes instead of full DTO selection
profiles.compact5_matched: Diagnostic only: compact projection of exactly legacy5 tool records, verify final source fragments equal, never method selection

retrieval.floor_note: fixed benchmark replay floor, not calibration of production relevance threshold

runtime.estimator: existing conservative UTF8-byte token-unit estimator, not provider actual tokens

comparison.metric: answer token F1 over official aliases, all failures zero
comparison.groups: shared supporting source groups, question-weighted paired bootstrap

efficiency_alternative.purpose: Independent predeclared engineering acceptance, not quality improvement claim

comparison.decision: Quality gate or efficiency gate plus all common gates. One fixed candidate; no grid search or reselection. If neither passes DEV, stop without confirmation.
comparison.diagnostic: matched evidence arm reports source-fragment equality, tokens and F1 descriptively; no further candidate selected from it.

budget_controls: Same configured budget comparison plus exact-evidence-matched compact arm. Actual tokens are measured, not assumed equal. Matched source sets are not token-matched; no claim of isolated algorithmic gain at identical actual tokens.
identifier_policy: Question/hop IDs absent in model input; use opaque source identities in baseline, short run-scoped citations in compact; gold labels only scoring.
api_policy: Single attempt per pair, no retry, knownHTTP400 retained0; stop unknown/wrong-model/other provider errors or invalid>5%; all in-flight results retained.
stop: One implementation,160 DEV selection,at most one200 confirmation. No parameter sweeps. Negative results retained. No unchanged passing tests repeated without relevant change.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
